subject: general
question: Sankirtana is a style of ________, one of the classical dances of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sankirtana** is a style of **Manipuri**, one of the classical dances of India.
 
• There are** 8 classical dances of India** in total whose mention is found in the **Natya Shastra** of** Bharat Muni**. These dances are recognized by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi** which is the national academy for performing arts in India.
 
• Manipuri dance originates from the Indian state of **Manipur**.
 
• Its central themes are the **love stories of Krishna and Radha** but other themes are also followed.
